detail: Every researched local contest has an event/result-state row, but exhaustive list/candidate vote/share/seat vectors remain untranscribed except detailed Žabljak 2018. Missing numeric values are null/status-coded, never zero.
The 2022 Šavnik local process remained incomplete in later official proceedings. No final result is asserted.
Local archive depth before the documented cycles is uneven. No older contests are invented to force a three-cycle pattern.
Historical Tuzi-within-Podgorica and Golubovci identities are separate from current Tuzi/Zeta; no guessed successor edges.
National history begins with post-independence Montenegro; Serbia-and-Montenegro federal offices are excluded.
Assemblies are directly elected; municipal presidents/mayors are elected by assemblies. Direct local executive count = 0.
DIK final-result archive establishes the 2016 parliamentary contest, but list-level numeric vector is not transcribed.
Montenegro is an EU candidate, not a Member State. EP offices = 0.
No prospective unified local-election event is created without an authoritative called/scheduled office binding.
Source hashes authenticate normalized evidence extracts retained in this pack, not remote official source bytes.
The 2006 final return states 338,835 valid ballots, while the twelve listed vote figures transcribed from it sum to 338,833. Both source claims are preserved; no two-vote correction is invented.
